mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Y-o-y GDPC1 growth accelerates by > 2pp but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the ISM manufacturing index (proxied by INDPRO) falls below 50, indicating a contraction in manufacturing activity, it predicts negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the slowing industrial sector weighs on the broader economy.
failure_condition: INDPRO < 50 but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) over a 3-month period signals a rapidly weakening labor market, which predicts negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as consumer spending and economic growth slow.
failure_condition: UNRATE rises > 0.5pp in 3 months but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in > 50% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) rises above 4%, it signals a restrictive monetary policy that will slow economic growth and produce negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS > 4% but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) both show year-over-year declines, it signals a broad weakening in consumer demand that predicts negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Y-o-y HOUST and RSAFS both decline but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in > 50% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the ISM manufacturing index (proxied by INDPRO) is above 60 and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 4%, it signals a tight labor market and strong industrial demand that will drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO > 60 and UNRATE < 4% but SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the CPI inflation rate (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 3% and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is rising, it signals a tightening monetary policy in response to high inflation that will produce negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL > 3% and rising FEDFUNDS but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in > 50% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When payroll employment (PAYEMS) shows a 3-month decline of more than 200,000 jobs, it signals a rapidly weakening labor market that predicts negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: PAYEMS declines > 200k jobs in 3 months but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.
